description.en: Lisk is the modern money operations platform for businesses. Finance and operations teams use Lisk to run accounts, payments, and approvals in one workspace, moving money across fiat and stablecoin rails. Lisk is built for companies that operate across borders, entities, and currencies, replacing the patchwork of tools they use today with a single platform for everyday business finance. LSK is Lisk's loyalty token. It lives on Base and Ethereum, with Base as its primary Layer 2 network. Over time, businesses will earn rewards for running their money operations on Lisk and for referring other companies, with additional LSK utility rolling out in phases. Live since 2016, Lisk is one of the longest-running projects in the industry. Today that experience goes into a focused mission: making business finance work the way modern companies do.
